events.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 18 | Based on Honobu Yonezawa's novel. Set in 16th century Japan, follows Lord Murashige Araki who, besieged in his castle, confronts mysterious crimes and allies with imprisoned strategist Kanbei Kuroda to uncover the truth.

events.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 18 | On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with mad science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

events.title: Late Fame
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 18 | Willem Dafoe plays a one-time poet who now works at the post office - until his work from decades ago is rediscovered by a group of avant-garde young artists who want to adopt him as their muse...or mascot.

events.title: Coyote vs. Acme
events.description: OPENS AUGUST 28 | After enduring years of catastrophic product failures at the hands of ACME, Inc., a tenacious, unemployed coyote uncovers a corporate cover-up and spearheads an unhinged battle against the multinational conglomerate that’s been blowing him up in the name of profit. Also, there’s a roadrunner. And dynamite.

events.title: Trash Plate Trivia at Dragonfly
events.description: Garbage-plate rounds, cheap pitchers, bragging rights.

events.title: AngstLAB, $3 cover, drink specials all night
events.description: Goth/industrial night. Cheap wells until last call.
